relations: Sun disk near center horizon casts a bright glitter patch directly below on the calm water surface.
Gentle surface ripples wobble and vertically stretch the sun-glitter patch frame to frame.
Traveling ripple bands break the reflection into shifting horizontal bands that reform across open water.
Undulating surface subtly deforms mirrored cloud shapes while sky and tree lines stay static.
caption: The video captures a wide, eye-level view of a calm lake at low sun, the bright disk sitting just above the horizon near center, partly veiled by clouds and streaked overhead by aircraft contrails. A dense, autumn-toned tree line fills the left bank, a thin distant line spans the far shore, and a few bare twigs poke from the foreground water. The sky, clouds, contrails, and tree lines show no detectable drift, and the horizon framing stays constant, indicating a static shot. The visible motion lives entirely on the water surface, where the bright sun-glitter patch wobbles and stretches vertically from frame to frame. This shimmering reflection repeatedly breaks into shifting horizontal ripple bands that travel and reform across the open water. Reflected cloud shapes, most visibly the dark masses in the lower right and the bright streaks mid-frame, subtly deform and reposition as the surface undulates. These mirrored forms continually distort and resettle with the lake's gentle ripple. This quiet agitation is the only change, already underway on the first frame and continuing past the last.
